verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents an official CLI (ldcli) for macOS, Windows, and Linux that manages feature flags, members, projects, environments, teams, and other resources from the command line, and a probe confirms the official CLI documentation. Missing for 10: documented agent-oriented features such as machine-readable/JSON output or non-interactive auth for AI workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: set up and manage your feature flags, account members, projects, environments, teams, and other resources directly from the command line.
The LaunchDarkly CLI is available for macOS, Windows, and Linux.
